selection_order: Filter train pairs to automatic pass, zero full-crop unusable pixels, target>=25 pixels.
For each event retain exact annotation-date post image; select latest pre_date among this qualifying pair pool, tie by pair_id.
Require selected pair target-median NDVI drop >=0.15.
Use seeded event hash and distinct train groups to choose up to six per source stratum.
clarification: A later clean pre with target<25 pixels was excluded before the nearest-pre choice. This is not necessarily the absolute nearest clean pre observation.
comparison: The replacement scan instead chooses absolute nearest clean pre first, then tests target size and NDVI drop. Its eligible counts differ.
timing_evidence: Acceptance bounds must derive only from complete inspected timeline states, not from selection pairs, annotation dates, or NDVI.
